# HadTech (Hadar Representations and Holdings Ltd)

> HadTech opens the Israeli electronics, defense and industrial market for European technology vendors. Exclusive representation, design-in, qualification and business development, led by more than 25 years of advanced-electronics executive experience and direct access to Israel's defense primes.

## About
HadTech is the brand of Hadar Representations and Holdings Ltd, based in Kiryat Motzkin, Israel. It represents European technology vendors (semiconductors, power, RF, sensors, embedded, EMS, defense and dual-use) in the Israeli and EMEA market. Founded and led by Yaniv Hadar.

## Services
- Market entry and exclusive Israel / EMEA representation
- Design-in and qualification (AS9100, ISO 13485)
- Business development and sales to defense primes, industrial and medical OEMs
- Strategic partnership: representation to JV, equity and local production

## Principal
Yaniv Hadar, Founder. Technology executive and serial entrepreneur, 25+ years. Former CEO of EMT (IMCO Group), a 70 person advanced-electronics manufacturer taken through a turnaround from receivership to a successful exit. Earlier: Marvell Semiconductor. Board member, Manufacturers Association of Israel.

## Domains
Semiconductors; Embedded and rugged computing; Power electronics; RF and microwave; Sensors and navigation; Test and measurement; EMS and manufacturing; Defense and dual-use.

## Hebrew summary
HadTech (הדר נציגויות ואחזקות) פותחת את השוק הישראלי עבור יצרני טכנולוגיה אירופיים: נציגות בלעדית, design-in, הסמכה ופיתוח עסקי, על בסיס יותר מ-25 שנות ניהול בכיר באלקטרוניקה מתקדמת וגישה ישירה ליצרניות הביטחון בישראל.
